datasets.name: UCI-HAR
datasets.scope: Complete official release, including the original train/test windows, inertial signals, labels and documentation.
datasets.creators: Jorge L. Reyes-Ortiz, Davide Anguita, Alessandro Ghio, Luca Oneto and Xavier Parra
datasets.license_label: UCI CC BY 4.0 listing + original notice
datasets.license_note: UCI currently lists CC BY 4.0. The bundled README also contains a prohibition on commercial use. Both original statements are retained; this mirror does not resolve the discrepancy or certify commercial reuse. Consult the original creators before relying on commercial-use rights.
datasets.citation: Davide Anguita, Alessandro Ghio, Luca Oneto, Xavier Parra and Jorge L. Reyes-Ortiz. A Public Domain Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones. ESANN, 2013.
datasets.checksum_scope: IoTBench mirror snapshot, 2026-10-28; official archives may change

datasets.name: WISDM
datasets.scope: The AR v1.1 release used by the six-class leaderboard task. This is a different release from Actitracker v2 and the later smartphone/smartwatch dataset.
datasets.creators: Jennifer R. Kwapisz, Gary M. Weiss, Samuel A. Moore and the WISDM Lab, Fordham University
datasets.license_note: The authors permit sharing/redistribution and request that the original readme.txt always accompanies the dataset, and that the specified paper is cited when using it. The archive and the standalone original README are preserved. No Creative Commons license is assigned by this mirror.
datasets.citation: Jennifer R. Kwapisz, Gary M. Weiss and Samuel A. Moore (2010). Activity Recognition using Cell Phone Accelerometers. Fourth International Workshop on Knowledge Discovery from Sensor Data (KDD-10), Washington DC. Citation follows the original dataset README.
datasets.checksum_scope: IoTBench mirror snapshot, 2026-10-28; official archives may change

datasets.name: PAMAP2
datasets.scope: The full original Protocol and Optional recordings with the original documentation. Leaderboard protocols can use a smaller subject/activity subset.
datasets.creators: Attila Reiss; research publications by Attila Reiss and Didier Stricker, DFKI
datasets.license_note: Retain attribution and the license/source links. The original README describes academic/scientific use and requests both Reiss–Stricker 2012 publications; both references are included below and in the citation files.
datasets.citation:
Attila Reiss and Didier Stricker. Introducing a New Benchmarked Dataset for Activity Monitoring. ISWC, 2012.
Attila Reiss and Didier Stricker. Creating and Benchmarking a New Dataset for Physical Activity Monitoring. ABRA, 2012.
datasets.checksum_scope: IoTBench mirror snapshot, 2026-10-28; official archives may change

datasets.name: HHAR
datasets.scope: Complete UCI bundle: both the activity-recognition experiment and the still-device experiment, including their original documentation.
datasets.creators: Henrik Blunck, Sourav Bhattacharya, Thor Siiger Prentow, Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard and Anind Dey
datasets.license_note: Give the dataset creators appropriate credit, retain the source/license links and original notices, and cite the Stisen et al. SenSys 2015 paper identified in both original READMEs.
datasets.citation: Allan Stisen, Henrik Blunck, Sourav Bhattacharya, Thor Siiger Prentow, Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard, Anind Dey, Tobias Sonne and Mads Møller Jensen. Smart Devices are Different: Assessing and Mitigating Mobile Sensing Heterogeneities for Activity Recognition. SenSys, 2015.

datasets.name: OPPORTUNITY
datasets.summary: 4 participants · wearable, object and ambient sensors
datasets.scope: One complete original archive supports both the gesture-recognition and locomotion tasks. It includes recordings, label definitions, documentation and the original benchmark tools.
datasets.creators: Daniel Roggen, Alberto Calatroni, Long-Van Nguyen-Dinh, Ricardo Chavarriaga, Hesam Sagha and the OPPORTUNITY consortium
datasets.license_note: Retain the original consortium credits and notices. The original README requests the Roggen et al. 2010 dataset paper or the Chavarriaga et al. 2013 benchmark paper; both are supplied below.
datasets.citation:
Daniel Roggen et al. Collecting complex activity data sets in highly rich networked sensor environments. INSS, 2010.
Ricardo Chavarriaga et al. The Opportunity challenge: A benchmark database for on-body sensor-based activity recognition. Pattern Recognition Letters, 2013.
